summary: L.P.G. distributorship allotment dispute; land eligibility under Corporation guidelines; sole vs. joint ownership/lease requirements; field verification compliance; shifting affidavit by lessor on land parcels; separate contiguous plots confirmed by revenue records; alternate land offered post-application due to lessor's changed stance; modification to 2015 guidelines permits alternate land acceptance; no disqualification for offering initially unsuitable land; NOC requirement only for joint ownership; High Court judgments upheld; Civil Appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Mrinmoy Maity Vs. Chhanda Koley (SLP(C) No.30152 of 2018)
final_judgment: Civil Appeal dismissed; High Court judgments upheld; parties to bear their own costs.
